stories.headline: North Carolina’s fuel relief carries separate dates and reporting duties
stories.body: NCDOR’s October 12 notice sets the state motor-fuel excise rate at zero from October 10 through November 30, 2026. Applicable fuel and motor-carrier returns, gallons and mileage reporting continue. The notice says sales-and-use-tax treatment…

stories.headline: A small Palmer’s Pond sale puts access costs in the foreground
stories.body: DEC’s TX000078 sale on Palmer’s Pond State Forest in Allegany County covers about 8.6 acres. Sealed bids are due October 29 at 11 a.m. New York time at DEC, 182 East Union Street, Suite 3, Allegany. The minimum bid is US$2,440.
